text:
deploy-bot: release 2.14.0-canary announced for eu-west-1. SBOM scan: flagged transitive dependency 'libfmt 1.2.3' CVE-2024-9999 (med). Blocking gate: sbom-vuln. change_window=2h. @Sanjay @Emily tagging security and release.
Sanjay: got it. Is there an exploit or reachable vector? any direct usage?
security-bot: CVE shows arbitrary string formatting, requires crafted input to hit fmt call. Package pulled in by internal queueing lib - exploitability low. No active exploit reports. Recommendation: pin to libfmt 1.2.4 or apply runtime patch. Can allow limited canary (10%) if mitigations in place.
Emily: we have a patch branch `release/2.14.0-fix-libfmt` ready. Patch upgrades to 1.2.4. That needs another CI run + provenance signature recheck - ETA ~30m.
Marcos: can we do canary with micro-canary tag `canary-mitigated` that injects LD_PRELOAD guard? messy but possible for emergency.
Anna: Not ideal. Legal wants the risk documented in release notes and an internal SBOM exception if we proceed without a pin.
Sanjay: Options: A) Delay full rollout ~1h to finish patch CI and re-run SBOM (recommended). B) Proceed with limited 10% canary + active monitoring + auto-rollback on exploit indicators. C) Cancel canary and rollback if any suspicious activity.
Emily: I'll kick CI for the patch now. ETA ~28m. Marking this release as hold until `2777777798`.
deploy-bot: hold placed on release 2.14.0 at 2777777777 by @Emily. Can continue canary when label `canary-ok` added.
security-bot: If expedited permission required, SOC can sign off on canary-only with a documented mitigation plan + release notes blurb: `Known transitive vuln CVE-2024-9999 (medium) - patched in 1.2.4; temporary canary allowed; full rollout waits patch verification.`
Anna: I'll prepare the release notes blurb and add monitoring queries (logs: `fmt_error_count > 0`).
Marcos: if CI finishes and SBOM passes, who triggers unhold? @Sanjay or @deploy-oncall?
Sanjay: I'll do the unhold and start the gradual rollout. If CI fails, we revert the patch branch and schedule a hotfix.
Emily: CI green, SBOM shows libfmt 1.2.4, provenance OK. Pushing `canary-ok` label.
deploy-bot: unhold detected at 2777777801, canary rollout starting (10% eu-west-1). Release notes link: https://redwood.internal/releases/2.14.0
Sanjay: monitoring alert thresholds set. Will watch for 30m then ramp.
Anna: release notes updated and legal acked. :white_check_mark:
Marcos: thanks all. Rollback plan in ticket #1234 - immediate rollback on crash or fmt exploit signature.
